meta.name: hybrid-cloud-networking
meta.description: Configure secure, high-performance connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms using VPN and dedicated connections. Use when building hybrid cloud architectures, connecting data centers to cloud, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.

copy.tagline: 构建本地与云端的安全连接通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地数据中心与云平台间建立安全连接
copy.tagline_en: Connect your on-premises data center to cloud securely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish secure connectivity between on-premises and cloud.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会帮你规划并配置本地数据中心与 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 之间的 VPN 或专线连接,产出 Terraform 配置、BGP 路由和高可用方案。
howto.when: 当你需要把本地机房连到云、把数据中心扩展到云,或搭建本地与云之间的混合云组网时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我把本地机房通过 Site-to-Site VPN 连到 AWS VPC
say.note: 会给出 VPN 网关与连接的 Terraform 配置

say.text: 用 Direct Connect 加 BGP 做双隧道主备高可用
say.note: 输出双隧道与故障切换路由配置

say.text: 配一下本地到 Azure 和 GCP 的多云专线互联

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude plans and configures connectivity between your on-premises data center and AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI over VPN or dedicated links, producing Terraform configs, BGP routing, and high-availability setups.
howto.when_en: Use it when connecting on-premises infrastructure to a cloud, extending a data center to cloud, or building hybrid or multi-cloud connectivity.

say_en.text: Connect my on-prem data center to an AWS VPC with a Site-to-Site VPN
say_en.note: Returns VPN gateway and connection Terraform config

say_en.text: Set up Direct Connect with BGP and dual tunnels for failover
say_en.note: Outputs dual-tunnel HA and failover routing

say_en.text: Wire on-prem to Azure and GCP with dedicated links
